# Glasses device add / search / connect flow

## 1. Current navigation chain (Device tab "+" → connected home)

```text
/  GlassesTabPage (tab 0 = Device)
 └─ HomePage
      └─ DeviceHomePage
           "+" tap → context.push('/device/search')
                └─ DeviceSearchPage  [feature_device_search]
                     • auto-starts BLE scan on mount
                     • filters by productId=11 (glasses) via sys/device/infoList
                     • empty scan pass → pushReplacement('/device/search/not-found')
                     • tap device → context.push('/device/connect', extra: BleDevice)
                          └─ GlassesConnectPage  [apps/glasses_app — wired in app_router]
                               • auto-connect on mount
                               • phases: connecting → success | failed
                               • success: "Start Exploring" → context.go('/')  → DeviceHomePage (connected)
                               • fail retry: context.go('/device/search')
```

```18:18:/Users/jace/Documents/newapp/apps/glasses_app/lib/app_shell/home_page.dart
        onAddDevice: () => context.push(DeviceRoutePaths.search),
```

**Search → connect bridge** (assembled in `widget_device`)

```31:46:/Users/jace/Documents/newapp/packages/widget/device/widget_device/lib/src/routing/device_routes.dart
          onDeviceSelectedProvider.overrideWith(
            (ref) => (device) {
              final known = ref.read(connectedDevicesProvider);
              if (known.any((item) => item.deviceId == device.id)) {
                // ... toast deviceAlreadyBound
                return;
              }
              ref.read(deviceSearchControllerProvider.notifier).stopScan();
              final ctx = navigatorKey.currentContext;
              if (ctx != null && ctx.mounted) {
                ctx.push(DeviceRoutePaths.connect, extra: device);
              }
            },
          ),
```

**App-local connect UI** (replaces generic `DeviceConnectPage` when `extra` is a `BleDevice`)

```29:35:/Users/jace/Documents/newapp/apps/glasses_app/lib/app_router.dart

```

## 5. Gaps vs native iOS chain

Reference: **Device Tab → type selector → glasses subtype (camera/audio) → open glasses → search → connection (connecting/success/fail) → explore → home**

| Native step | Flutter today | Gap |
|-------------|---------------|-----|
| **Device Tab** | `GlassesTabPage` / `DeviceHomePage` | Aligned |
| **Type selector (grid/list)** | Not implemented; "+" goes straight to search | **Full screen missing** — no route, no page, no l10n |
| **Glasses subtype (camera / audio)** | No subtype picker; scan filter hardcodes `productId: 11` in app.dart; `filterCode` supported in provider but never set | **UI missing**; cannot branch BK camera vs audio glasses at add time |
| **Open glasses** | Pairing instructions only as `scanHint` on search header | **No dedicated prep/onboarding step** before scan |
| **Search** | `DeviceSearchPage` with radar UI, server name allowlist, RSSI sort | **Mostly aligned** with `MyDevice/DeviceSearch/` / `GlassesSearchActivity` |
| **Search not found** | `DeviceSearchNotFoundPage` | **Aligned** (`GlassesSearchErrActivity` parity noted in code) |
| **Connection phases** | `GlassesConnectPage` (connecting / success / fail) | **Aligned** (`GlassesConnectActivity` parity) |
| **Explore** | Success button → `context.go('/')` | **Aligned** (inline, not separate route) |
| **Home** | Same `DeviceHomePage`; shows `--` battery when disconnected | **Aligned** for connected state; no separate “empty device” home — home always shows glasses chrome |

**Additional implementation gaps**

1. **Shortcut add flow:** Flutter skips 2–3 native screens (type selector, subtype, open-glasses) and jumps `+` → search.
2. **Name search field:** ARB has `searchHint` / `emptySearch` but `DeviceSearchPage` has no text filter UI.
3. **Generic connect hub unused:** `DeviceConnectPage` and its l10n are dead on the glasses happy path; only showcase / no-builder paths use them.
4. **`DeviceSearchEntryItem` unused in glasses_app:** showcase uses it; glasses_app uses direct `push(search)`.
5. **Already-bound guard:** toast + early return if device ID is in `connectedDevicesProvider`; no native-style re-bind flow.
6. **Auto-connect:** may reach connected home without ever showing search/connect UI.
7. **Disconnected home:** home still renders full feature grid; many actions toast “coming soon” or “device not connected” rather than gating the whole tab.
8. **No connect assets in feature package:** connect hero comes from app assets; not shareable across apps without duplication.

**What is in good shape**

- Route assembly pattern (`widget_device.deviceRoutes` + app `connectPageBuilder`) is clean and extensible.
- Search filter plumbing (`DeviceSearchFilterConfig`, `deviceNameFilterProvider`) mirrors native `WKDeviceSearchFilter` / `infoList`.
- Connect success/fail UX and not-found troubleshooting pages are implemented with explicit native parity comments.
- Post-connect identity sync (`DeviceIdentitySyncController`) handles glasses protocol handshake after BLE connect.

---

### Quick layer map

```text
App (glasses_app)
  app_router.dart          — routes + GlassesConnectPage builder
  app_shell/home_page.dart — "+" entry
  app_shell/device_home_page.dart — connected home
  app_shell/glasses_connect_page.dart — connect phases + explore

Widget (widget_device)
  device_routes.dart       — search/connect bridge, ProviderScope overrides

Feature
  feature_device_search    — search + not-found pages, scan controller, filters
  feature_device_connect     — connect controller, generic hub, auto-connect, identity sync
  feature_device_settings    — /device/settings (orthogonal)
```
